title: Slimdown shard index and isolate tokenizer init flow
creator: Aisha Kline
description: Background: Our model startup time analysis (dashboard link below) shows that ~30-40% of model cold-start latency comes from two sources: (1) the heavyweight shard index parsing in the loader and (2) synchronous tokenizer initialization that eagerly loads full vocab/merges for models that only need a small subset during warmup. This ticket aims to reduce tail latency and memory pressure during model bootstrap by introducing a slim shard index format (manifest-v2) and isolating tokenizer init into a separate lazy/async pipeline that can be parallelized and paged.
acceptance_criteria:
1) Average model cold-start 90th percentile reduces by >=20% on our CI perf harness for representative Llama-variant checkpoints.
2) Loader no longer parses full per-shard metadata for shards not required for initial activation (shard map lazy-resolve).
3) Tokenizer initialization happens off the hot path: models return to Ready state earlier while tokenizer completes background prefetch.
4) Backwards compatibility: existing manifest-v1 artifacts continue to load via a thin adapter shim.
5) New manifest-v2 is documented and a conversion script is available in tools/manifest-convert.
6) Regression tests (unit + integration) added to ci/model-load to validate both manifest versions and tokenizer-stub behavior.
design_notes:
Decision summary:
- Introduce manifest-v2: a compact shard index that lists shard id, approximate byte range, and a small feature mask (quantized/float, kv-enabled). Keep manifest-v1 readable via an adapter for now.
- Tokenizer init split: add TokenizerInitService which runs in a bounded thread pool and exposes a future-based API; loader will attach a lightweight TokenizerStub that implements tokenization ops minimally until full vocab is ready (fallback to subword-on-demand).
- Trade-offs: TokenizerStub simplifies startup but may slightly degrade first-request tokenization throughput; mitigated via prioritized prefetch for high-frequency tokens.
- Dependency change: bump protobuf from 3.20.x -> 3.24.x to use the new zero-copy parsing helpers for manifest-v2. This requires a short compatibility audit for any serialization code (see deps section).
implementation_plan:
1) Prototype manifest-v2 schema and a fast parser using zero-copy (week 1).
2) Implement TokenizerInitService + TokenizerStub and wire into loader bootstrap (week 2).
3) Add adapter layer to read manifest-v1 via a compatibility shim (week 2).
4) Add conversion tool (tools/manifest-convert) and run on CI sample artifacts (week 3).
5) Add unit and integration tests; run perf harness and iterate (week 3).
6) Code review, staged rollout behind feature flag 'loader.slim_index' (week 4).
7) Monitor runtime-1.20 staging for regressions and flip flag for GA after 2 weeks of stable metrics.
